build_coco_evaluator: build a COCOEvaluator instance to evaluate object detection, segmentation, or keypoint predictions on a dataset
test_evaluate_predictions: test the _eval_predictions method to evaluate COCO-format predictions and compute AP metrics for bbox, segm, or keypoints tasks
test_evaluate_box_proposals: test the _eval_box_proposals method to evaluate detection proposal recall metrics across area ranges and limits
summarize_coco_results: summarize COCOeval results into per-category and overall AP, AP50, AP75, APs, APm, APl metrics for a given iou_type
test_instances_to_coco_json: test the instances_to_coco_json function to convert Instances objects to COCO-format JSON annotations for evaluation
